title: An electric dipole 5 nm from a 10 nm metal wire (n = 0.97 + 1.87i), asked for 1e-9: the grazing error it cannot pass

series.label: 1e-9 × max Γ / Γ₀, the accuracy asked for

worst_label: smallest grazing error / accuracy asked (must stay above 1)
note: The light-line caps leave an error the integration cannot shrink; asked for 1e-9, PyStratify charges it to the total error and reports the result as not converged (16 of 16 wavelengths), rather than claiming an accuracy it does not have. The grazing error is all but 0.3% of the reported error, so the two lines coincide. The same wire as the grazing-caps rows; 40 orders; no dispersion.
